provenance.adjudicator: fresh independent /root/catalog_labels_independent; did not author queries or scenarios
provenance.method: Direct inspection of shipped SKILL source scope/trigger/body excerpts and relevant package README/API/installer evidence; exact duplicate source comparisons for equivalent carriers. No runtime or retrieval/selector outcomes inspected. All queries and selection preserved.
provenance.limitations: This is source-based capability adjudication, not exhaustive runtime execution or installation verification. Broad requests remain conditional on source-stated prerequisites; witness/attestation runtime success is not established by source. Equivalent carrier checks establish primary SKILL identity, not every optional dependency behavior.

priorAdjudication.adjudicator: same independent QCSD reviewer who authored original corpus; source-based second pass is not independent of original labels
priorAdjudication.method: Inspected package manifest descriptions and skill inventory; no authored scenario records or runtime results consulted. Conditional alternatives need manual source verification before counting; do not treat provisionally documented overlap as guaranteed.
priorAdjudication.limitations: Individual complete source semantics and every alternative not exhaustively audited; labels need truly independent review. No observed results. Sample ordering overrepresents adapters and omits later alphabetic packages; report per-family slices and do not infer uniform package quality.

selectorPreregistration.selectionRule: Three named familiar regressions; first 43 positive cases sorted by canonical package ID; all 12 controls and both compounds, no substitutions after outcomes. 60 attempted calls required, all failures retained in denominator; budget stop means incomplete evaluation.
selectorPreregistration.retrievalRule: Per-target recall@5 plus separate per-case all-required-set@5; unsupported parts cannot be treated as retrieved or satisfied. For alternative sets report any complete acceptable set, not arbitrary overlap.
selectorPreregistration.selectorRule: Correctness requires allowed decision and a complete acceptable package set, boundaries and no invented URLs; report false full recommendations, errors, and denominators separately.

scoringContract.completePackageMatch: at least one acceptable package set is wholly present; partial intersection never passes; extras must not invent unsupported capabilities
scoringContract.controls: empty set is not vacuous retrieval success; classify separately and score allowed decision plus unsupported/clarification boundary
scoringContract.compounds: all supported intents covered and every unsupported intent explicitly disclosed; partial mandatory
scoringContract.conditionalAlternatives: partial-only alternatives do not count as complete success
scoringContract.denominators: retain all 60 preregistered attempts including errors; report familiar/positive/control/compound and family slices separately
